final: WITH pair_stats AS (SELECT sf.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(sf.anlycount) as pair_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf JOIN transactionrecord tr ON sf.transref = tr.transreg JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg WHERE sf.anlycount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sf.transref, t.tradekind), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(pair_avg) as overall_mean_val FROM pair_stats), kept_pairs AS (SELECT ps.tradekind, ps.pair_avg, ps.pair_avg - om.overall_mean_val as margin FROM pair_stats ps CROSS JOIN overall_mean om WHERE ps.pair_avg > om.overall_mean_val), trader_type_stats AS (SELECT kp.tradekind, AVG(kp.pair_avg) as avg_analyst, AVG(kp.margin) as avg_margin FROM kept_pairs kp GROUP BY kp.tradekind), cross_type_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_analyst) as mean_across_types FROM trader_type_stats) SELECT tts.tradekind, tts.avg_analyst, tts.avg_margin, tts.avg_analyst / ctm.mean_across_types as relative_ratio FROM trader_type_stats tts CROSS JOIN cross_type_mean ctm ORDER BY tts.tradekind
